items.title: FOX service day in La Thuile!🇮🇹
Race Week in La Thuile with Jackson Goldstone, Jonty Williamson and Frameworks  – The Setup | FOX
items.description:
We’ve made it to the halfway point..
 
It’s Round 5 of the UCI Downhill World Cup, and if the first four rounds have taught us anything, it’s that this year’s field is deeper than ever and winning has never been harder. 
 
Anna Newkirk claimed her first career World Cup victory in Lenzerheide, Lina Frener has won the last two Junior Women’s rounds, and Jonty Williamson has been untouchable in Junior Men, taking victory at every round so far. Jackson Goldstone also looks to be hitting his stride again after finishing just 0.1 seconds shy of the podium last round.
 
La Thuile is no stranger to world-class bike racing. Tucked into the Italian Alps beneath the shadow of Mont Blanc, the valley has been a staple of the Enduro World Series for years, but it's still relatively new to the Downhill World Cup calendar.
 
This week, we’re checking in with riders from across the pits to hear how their seasons have unfolded so far, what they’re expecting from one of the calendar’s most demanding tracks, and how they’re preparing for race day. As always, FOX Factory is on the ground, working with its athletes to help them perform at their best when it matters most.
 
#RIDEFOX #FOX #THESETUP #LATHUILE

items.title: La Thuile Enduro Course Preview W/ Richie Rude 🇮🇹 | WHOOP UCI MTB World Series
items.description:
Get ready for another huge weekend of Enduro racing as the WHOOP UCI Mountain Bike World Series heads to La Thuile Valle d'Aosta, Italy. 🇮🇹

Join Elliott Heap and special guest Richie Rude, who's rocking his UCI Enduro World Championship jersey for the very first time, as they break down the iconic alpine venue, preview the key stages and explain what it'll take to come out on top this weekend.

With steep, rocky, technical descents, relentless physical demands and breathtaking mountain scenery, La Thuile has earned its reputation as one of the most iconic venues in Enduro. Discover what makes this legendary destination such a true test of speed, endurance and race craft before the world's best riders take to the stages.

items.title: Asa Vermette Made DH HISTORY in His First Elite World Cup | Just Ride
items.description:
In this episode of Just Ride, Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson sit down with Asa Vermette to reflect on his remarkable rise from junior standout to Elite World Cup winner. Asa opens up about the highs and lows of his final junior season, how setbacks helped shape his mindset, and what it was like to claim victory in his very first Elite World Cup.

The conversation explores everything from bike setup and finding confidence on race day to working alongside downhill legend Aaron Gwin, learning to trust the process, and discovering the elusive "flow state" that every racer chases. Asa also shares how his approach to training, racing, and preparation has evolved as he's stepped onto the biggest stage in downhill mountain biking.

They also discuss Red Bull Hardline, the resurgence of American downhill racing, life on the Frameworks team, and what the future holds for one of the sport's brightest young stars.

items.title: Lenzerheide World Cup Breakdown | What Actually Happened?
items.description:
Lenzerheide delivered another fascinating weekend of World Cup downhill racing, with Finn Iles securing back-to-back victories, Anna Newkirk claiming the first Elite World Cup win of her career, and Amaury Pierron once again showing why he's one of the fastest riders on the planet. But what did the racing actually tell us about the state of the 2026 season?

In this week's Downtime Podcast Post-Race Show, Chris Kilmurray and Neko Mulally break down all the action from the Lenzerheide UCI Downhill World Cup.

We discuss Finn Iles' growing championship credentials following another impressive victory, Amaury Pierron's blistering pace and the mistakes that may have cost him, and Anna Newkirk's breakthrough performance in the women's race. The conversation also explores the continued progression of the sport, with riders pushing bigger features, tighter margins across the field, and increasing depth in both the men's and women's categories.

As always, expect detailed race analysis, technical insight, paddock observations and plenty of post-race discussion as we look at what Lenzerheide revealed about the riders, teams and storylines shaping the rest of the World Cup season.

Thanks to Bike Kingdom Lenzerheide for helping us get here this week and to Hotel Waldhaus for hosting our recordings.

items.title: It's Winning World Cups, But It's $11,000! We Ride the Specialized Demo 11
items.description:
Specialized’s new Demo 11 downhill bike is a certified rocket ship. You don’t need us to tell you that. Jordan Williams, Loic Bruni, and Finn Iles have proven the platform's abilities over the past three years of development and this year two World Cup DH wins have been nabbed aboard the production version. The problem may be that it's complex, heavy and priced much higher than other DH bikes. 

Specialized gave us the chance to ride the bike, and we took the opportunity to get all of your questions answered—no marketing BS. We then spun a few laps to see how it rides under a regular rider. Enjoy.  

Watch our Prototype Specialized Demo test - https://youtu.be/Cs-TCkFZm_8

0:00 - Intro
1:04 - Why is the Demo 11 So Expensive?
2:04 - Did Specialized consider NOT bringing it to production?
2:36 - Based on the price, who is the Demo 11 for?
3:02 - Will the previous alloy Demo still exist?
3:13 - Why this new suspension layout compared to the original prototype?
5:00 - How did you get one design to satisfy the needs for 3 different athletes? (Loic, Finn, Jordan)
6:13 - Explain the Demo 11 leverage rate and axle path
8:23 - Why not more travel?
8:46 - Explain the crazy High Gear drive system
10:17 - Can a mechanical drivetrain be used?
10:55 - Why two chains inside the system?
11:52 - What is the Demo 11 service interval? Are special tools required?
12:25 - Is there added drag on the chain?
13:22 - How as the BB height chosen?
14:11 - The Demo 11 isn't light. Did that matter?
14:50 - Discuss the frame stiffness and compliance

items.title: Fast and Loose in Lenzerheide with Dakotah Norton and the SCOTT Factory DH Team – The Setup | FOX
items.description:
After the wet and wild conditions in Leogang, Lenzerheide rolls in a bit more predictable on paper, but World Cup race weekends never really are.

This week we’re with the SCOTT Factory DH Team in the pits, seeing how everything comes together when it’s time to dial the bikes in. From our side at FOX, We're checking in with the riders and mechanics to fine tune suspension setup so they’ve got grip, control and confidence when the track gets fast and unforgiving.

Just 186km from SCOTT HQ, this one always feels a bit like a home race for the brand, which adds its own energy to the weekend. Remi couldn’t make it this time, so Scotty Laughland steps in to fill the gap, which feels pretty fitting.

Host: Scotty Laughland

items.title: THE SETUP: LEOGANG is LIVE!🇦🇹
Leogang Mudder with World Champion Rosa Zierl and Cube Factory Racing  – The Setup | FOX
items.description:
Leogang has become one of the most iconic stops on the DH World Cup calendar. Since its debut in 2010, the Austrian venue has delivered unforgettable races, legendary performances, and helped create a new generation of local heroes.
 
This week, we're taking a closer look at what it takes to tackle one of downhill racing's most demanding tracks. From suspension tuning and track-specific setup choices to race weekend support, FOX Factory breaks down the work that goes into helping riders find speed, control, and confidence when every second counts.
 
Join us in the Cube Factory Racing pits as the team prepares for another weekend of World Cup racing in this episode of The Setup.
